001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventFactor;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventIntel;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseFactorTooltip;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI.TooltipCreator;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
012
013public class SDRGensKatoFactor extends BaseEventFactor {
014        
015        public SDRGensKatoFactor() {
016        }
017
018        @Override
019        public boolean shouldShow(BaseEventIntel intel) {
020                return true;
021        }
022        
023        @Override
024        public TooltipCreator getMainRowTooltip(final BaseEventIntel intel) {
025                return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
026                        @Override
027                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
028                                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
029                                
030                                tooltip.addPara("Fortuna Kato is using the wealth and influence of Gens Kato to openly support "
031                                                + "Achilles Andrada and his reformer faction as the next Supreme Executor.", 0f, h, "Fortuna Kato");
032                                
033                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_hannanBlockingKato")) {
034                                        tooltip.addPara("However, Reynard Hannan is using the power of the office of Prime Demarchon to undercut Gens Kato support "
035                                                        + "for Achilles Andrada through various bureaucratic maneuvers.", 8f, h, "Reynard Hannan");
036                                }
037                                else if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_hannanBlockingKato") &&
038                                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_horusBacksFortuna")) {
039                                        
040                                        tooltip.addPara("Reynard Hannan is trying to use the power of the office of Prime Demarchon to undercut Gens Kato support "
041                                                        + "for Achilles Andrada through various bureaucratic maneuvers.", 8f, h, "Reynard Hannan");
042                                }
043                                //$global.sdr_hannanBlockingKatoResolved
044                                
045                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_horusBacksFortuna")) {
046                                        tooltip.addPara("Horus Yaribay has thrown the support of Gens Yaribay behind Fortuna "
047                                                        + "Kato's efforts to install Achilles Andrada as the next Supreme Executor. "
048                                                        + "The influence of Gens Kato and Yaribay together are able to override the veto of the Prime Demarchon.", 8f, h, "Horus Yaribay");
049                                }
050                                else if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_horusBacksReynard")) {
051                                        tooltip.addPara("Horus Yaribay has thrown the support of Gens Yaribay behind Reynard Hannan. "
052                                                        + "With overwhelming votes in the All-League Council the Prime Demarchon may legally "
053                                                        + "draw upon exceptional powers to stymie Fortuna Kato's efforts.", 8f, h, "Horus Yaribay");
054                                }
055                        }
056                };
057        }
058
059        @Override
060        public String getProgressStr(BaseEventIntel intel) {
061//              if (getProgress(intel) <= 0) return "";
062                return super.getProgressStr(intel);
063        }
064        
065        @Override
066        public int getProgress(BaseEventIntel intel) {
067                int _amount = SDRPoints.KATO_SUPPORT; // this happens regardless!
068                
069                if(Global.getSector().getPlayerMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdse_proHector")) {
070                        _amount = SDRPoints.KATO_SUPPORT_PRO_HECTOR;
071                }
072                
073                if(     Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_hannanBlockingKato") && 
074                        !Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_horusBacksFortuna")) {
075                        _amount += SDRPoints.HANNAN_BLOCKS_SUPPORT;
076                }
077                //$global.sdr_hannanBlockingKatoResolved
078                                
079                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_horusBacksFortuna")) {
080                        _amount += SDRPoints.YARIBAY_SUPPORT;
081                }
082                else if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_horusBacksReynard")) {
083                        _amount -= SDRPoints.YARIBAY_SUPPORT;
084                }
085                                        
086                return _amount;
087        }
088
089        @Override
090        public String getDesc(BaseEventIntel intel) {
091                return "Gens Kato openly backs Achilles Andrada";
092        }
093        
094        @Override
095        public Color getDescColor(BaseEventIntel intel) {
096                if (getProgress(intel) != 0) return Misc.getTextColor();
097                return Misc.getGrayColor();
098        }
099}
